name: Good Hope, Greater
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, hope, mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, mesmerist 6

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell good hope except as noted above and grants a +4 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls and temporary hit points equal to your caster level.
